messages.subject: Packet E complete: 1 blocker remains
messages.body: Completed the read-only independent review of exact commit 33b97fcc4a78ab0e575664deacd2e12a50448931, observing GPT-6.1-Sol default in the local Codex-in-Orca harness and passing typecheck, 140 tests, index check, and restart smoke. Found 1 BLOCKER, 3 SHOULD-FIX, and 2 NOTE findings: B1/S1/S4 are PARTIAL and S2/S3 FIXED, with MCP contradictory reviews reproduced in 8 of 12 fresh JSON trials despite all 12 legacy-HTTP versus Commons races correctly returning 200/409. Remaining work is to serialize MCP writers, migrate existing observation imports, expose edge evidence, and retain rejection reasons; the repository is clean and all scratch servers are stopped.
